title: A repeated proposal_create is skipped, not minted twice
notes: 0.33.0 duplicate guard. The dedupe scan is SKIPPED under dryRun (the placeholder CID uses a different codec than a Pinata pin and could never match a live proposal), so this scenario MUST broadcast — it cannot be proved in --dry-run mode. Step 1 mints proposal N; step 2 re-sends byte-identical args and must come back mode 'already-created' with the create step skipped and no new tx. Written to be IDEMPOTENT: on a re-run while the first proposal is still live, step 1 itself returns 'already-created', which is why its assertion is an `in` over the three legitimate outcomes rather than `ne already-created`. Step 3 proves the allowDuplicate escape hatch is still accepted but keeps dryRun:true so it can never mint a real duplicate. Cost: up to 4 txs (prefund + approve + deposit + createProposalAndVote), ~cents on chain 97. NOTE: `broadcast:false` does not stop the composite — mode 'payloads' is always signed by the orchestrator; the flag only governs single-payload build_* steps.
